summary.prose: Building the outbox starts in S001's queue: the file moves to schema version 2 with a 'waiting on a card' flag, the store learns to resend a message to the resending window, and the worker gains one action entry point and a way to record the running message's card. On top of that a pure projection turns the queue's rows into the outbox for the shown chat, the chat host posts it and handles its actions, and the webview draws the band and the queue-shortcut hint. A hand check in VS Code closes the Story.

tasks.title: The queue file at schema version 2, with markWaiting and resendFrom
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts: the CREATE TABLE messages gains the nullable waiting_on column and SCHEMA_VERSION becomes 2; on open a version-1 file gets the column by ALTER TABLE in the open transaction and records version 2, keeping its rows; rowToMessage maps waiting_on to QueuedMessage.waitingOn. Add markWaiting(seq, on), which sets or clears waiting_on only on a processing row, and resendFrom(seq, newTurnId, windowKey), resend's single transaction with the given window key (AMD-7, AMD-4).
acceptanceChecks: A fresh file is created at version 2 with waiting_on; a version-1 file opens as version 2 with its rows kept and waitingOn empty
markWaiting sets and clears waitingOn on a processing row and returns false on any other state
resendFrom re-queues a failed or not-delivered message at the back with its text and attachments under the given window key, and refuses any other state
A file newer than version 2 is still refused with the newer-plugin message

tests.name: schema 2: a fresh queue file is created with the waiting_on column at version 2, and a processing row can be marked waiting
schema upgrade: a version-1 queue file opens as version 2 with its rows kept and waitingOn empty, and a newer file is still refused
markWaiting sets and clears waitingOn on a processing row only
resendFrom: a failed or not-delivered message joins the back with its text and attachments under the given window key; any other state is refused

tasks.title: The worker's act and the runner's onWaiting
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-worker.ts: ChatQueueWorker gains act(seq, 'cancel' | 'dismiss' | 'resend') -> { ok: true } | { ok: false; note }, applying store.cancel / dismiss / resendFrom(seq, newTurnId(), claim.windowKey), catching StoreBusy / unavailable into a note, and ticking at once on success (AMD-3). QueuedTurnRunner.run gains the optional onWaiting argument; runMessage passes a handler that writes markWaiting(message.seq, on), keeping the latest value to write again on the next tick if the write fails (AMD-8).
acceptanceChecks: act cancel removes a waiting message and is refused with a note once it has started; dismiss and resend likewise refuse rows in the wrong state
act resend hands the message to this window's key
An act that succeeds is seen by an onChange listener without waiting for a poll
onWaiting from the runner sets and clears waitingOn on the running message's row; a busy write is retried on the next tick

tests.name: worker act: cancel removes a waiting message and is refused once the message has started; dismiss and resend refuse rows in the wrong state; resend takes this window's key; a successful act is seen by onChange at once
worker onWaiting: the runner's card report sets and clears waitingOn on the running message, and a busy write is retried on the next tick

tasks.title: The outbox projection and its protocol messages
tasks.summary: New vscode-free module chat-outbox.ts (sc5): OutboxRow, OutboxView (with runningChat and blockedBy), OutboxAction and projectOutbox(rows, sessionId, ctx), a pure function. protocol.ts gains the host->webview 'outbox' message and the four outbox-* actions, added to HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES and WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES.
acceptanceChecks: Processing rows are never outbox rows; positions are 1-based among all waiting rows; failed and not-delivered rows have no position
aheadFromOtherChats counts only other chats' waiting rows ahead of this chat's first waiting row
runningChat names another chat's processing row (here when it is this window's); blockedBy comes from that row's waitingOn
The protocol lists include 'outbox' and the four actions, and the protocol tests' exhaustive lists are updated to match

tests.name: outbox projection: with a turn running, the chat's two waiting messages show places 2 and 3, one message from another chat is ahead, and the running chat is named
outbox projection: processing rows are dropped, failed and not-delivered rows have no place, blockedBy comes from another chat's processing row, attachments are counted and the note is carried
protocol: the host-to-webview and webview-to-host type lists include the outbox message and its four actions

tasks.title: The chat host posts the outbox and handles its actions
tasks.summary: In chat-panel.ts createChatPanelHost: subscribe to worker.onChange and keep the last rows; post the projected view for the shown chat after every change, in showSession, on 'ready' and after an action. Route outbox-cancel / -dismiss / -resend to worker.act (ignoring a seq that is not the shown chat's; outbox-retry-now ignored until s4) and re-post with the note on refusal.
acceptanceChecks: Messages sent while a turn runs appear in the posted outbox with their places, and leave it when they are taken
Cancel, dismiss and resend from the webview change the queue; a refused action is re-posted with its note; a seq of another chat is ignored
After the host is rebuilt over the same file and its webview is ready, the same outbox is posted
Without the queue no 'outbox' message is posted

tests.name: chat host outbox: two messages sent while a turn runs are posted in the outbox with their places, and another chat's earlier message is counted ahead
chat host outbox: cancelling a waiting message removes it from the queue and the outbox, and it never runs
chat host outbox: resending a failed message queues the same text and attachments at the back under this window's key, and it runs
chat host outbox: a refused action is re-posted with its note, a seq of another chat is ignored, and a taken message leaves the outbox
chat host outbox: after the host is rebuilt over the same queue file and its webview is ready, the outbox shows the same messages in the same places

tasks.title: The running queued message reports its cards, and every window shows blockedBy
tasks.summary: In chat-panel.ts: the queue runner passes onWaiting through for the running queued message: called with 'approval' or 'selection' when its first approval or selection card appears, and with undefined when no card of it is left waiting (answered, Stop, the wait timing out, or the run ending). The worker writes it (t2), and every host's outbox projection shows blockedBy from the processing row.
acceptanceChecks: While one host's running queued message waits on an approval, a second host on the same queue file posts an outbox whose blockedBy names that chat and 'approval'
The flag clears once the card is answered, and when the run ends
A selection card reports 'selection'
A turn not run from the queue reports nothing

tests.name: chat host outbox: while another window's running message waits on an approval, this window's outbox says which chat it waits on, and the line clears once the card is answered

tasks.title: The outbox band, its actions and the shortcut hint in the webview
tasks.summary: In the chat webview shell (chat-panel.ts renderShell): an #insrc-outbox band above the input bar, present only when the queue is on, drawn from 'outbox' with textContent (summary line with ahead / running / waiting-on, rows with place, first line, attachment count, error, and Cancel / Resend / Dismiss as role=button spans with keyboard activation), styled with the chat's theme variables in its rounded style. With the queue on, doSubmit no longer marks the turn running (the host's 'turn-running' does), and the hint '⌘/Ctrl+Enter to queue' is shown beside the message box while a turn runs.
acceptanceChecks: The shell has #insrc-outbox and the hint only when the queue is on
An 'outbox' message draws its rows and summary line (ahead, running, waiting on); an empty view hides the band
Each action posts its outbox-* message with the row's seq

With the queue on, submitting does not mark the turn running; the hint shows while a turn runs and hides after; without the queue, submitting still marks running locally and the existing tests for it stand

tests.name: chat shell: the outbox band and the queue shortcut hint are present only with the queue; an outbox message draws its rows and summary and each action posts its seq; with the queue a submit does not mark the turn running

tasks.title: Run the suites and check by hand
tasks.summary: Run the plugin's suite and typecheck, build, package and install the plugin, and have the user check the outbox in VS Code.
acceptanceChecks: The plugin's suite and typecheck pass apart from failures that existed before this Story

By hand: messages sent mid-turn show in the outbox with their places and leave it as they run; cancel removes one; a stopped message shows failed and Resend runs it; a reload keeps the outbox; the hint shows while a turn runs; with two windows, a waiting approval in one is named in the other's outbox

tests.name: The plugin's whole test suite and typecheck pass apart from failures that existed before this Story

By hand in VS Code: messages sent mid-turn show in the outbox with their places and leave it as they run; cancel removes one; a stopped message shows failed and Resend runs it; a reload keeps the outbox; the hint shows while a turn runs; with two windows, a waiting approval in one is named in the other's outbox
